subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): session placement, dispatch, and worker turn routing

question: Should milestone 3’s storage, protocol, startup-gating, and routing foundation land before its user dispatch surfaces, or remain staged until the complete milestone has end-to-end proof?
rationale: The PR intentionally establishes compatibility-sensitive stored state and protocol contracts while changing core session ownership and startup ordering; repository policy and the protected label require explicit owner intent on this landing boundary.

options.title: Hold for full proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the current head has no blocking recovery concerns and a real provision-to-teardown artifact proves the complete foundation.

options.title: Land the foundation
options.body: Accept the staged storage, protocol, and startup surfaces after maintainers explicitly verify upgrade and recovery behavior.

options.title: Split the milestone
options.body: Separate schema and protocol, dispatch, and runtime routing into narrower PRs with independent compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Hold for full proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the current head has no blocking recovery concerns and a real provision-to-teardown artifact proves the complete foundation.
